evidence: Returns &g_driverGroupTable.playerCarSetups[index]; the 7-byte record whose columns follow the setup screen labels (text 0x2b7..0x2bd: Tyres, Gearbox, Suspension, Power Ratio, Brake Bias, Brake Power, Steering) and that Car_Init applies to the car.
Returns the current country's default CarSetup from g_countryCarSetupBlock (Sweden's has the snow tyres, 6); one of the setups Car_Init can apply.
Returns g_challengeCarSetups[bits 10-11 * 3 + bits 12-13], the same index plus one that names the challenge map (chall\\cha%.2d.tga); Car_Init applies it when RallyData_GetFlag24 is set.
Maps the country (1/2, 3, 5, 7, 8; else the first) to one of the five setups of g_alternateCountryCarSetups; Car_Init uses it in game mode 4 and some flag 25 cases.
Copies the country's default CarSetup into the four player setups and moves an even tyre choice other than 6 to the next one in late championship stages.
Zeroes all seven columns of the four player car setups.
Car_Init passes CarSetup::brakePower (column 5, text "Brake Power"); sets maxBrakeForce = 1.2 * value + 0.2.

Car_Init passes CarSetup::steering (column 6, "Steering"/"Steering Sensitivity"); sets the outward and centring steering rates and the steering force scale read by CarPhysics_DampSurfaceSteeringAngle and AutoGear_IntegrateSteeringAccumulator.
Car_Init passes CarSetup::tyres (column 0, "Tyres"); stores the group of nine surface drag values the wheels use.
Car_Init passes CarSetup::suspension (column 2, "Suspension": soft for rough terrain, hard for tarmac); sets spring damping, lean damping, travel ranges and ride height from it.
Copies the four player car setups into rows 4..7 of g_optionCarSetups and mirrors them into the edited rows 0..3, clearing the changed-column flags.
Copies the edited rows 0..3 of g_optionCarSetups back into the four player car setups.
Returns a column of g_optionCarSetups[index + 4], the setup the player had on entering the screen.
Returns a column of the edited setup as the screen shows it: tyres and gearbox as stored, the five sliders divided by 10.
Stores a screen choice into the edited setup (sliders times 10) and charges the column's weight the first time it changes.
Copies one column of the entry setup back into the edited setup and clears its changed flag.
Whether the entry setup's column equals a screen choice (sliders times 10).
Whether a column of the edited setup still equals the entry setup's.
Returns g_pPauseMenu, the pause menu being shown (g_pauseMenus.main or .stageData; the update loop stores the menu Menu_Update returns).

Draws, for each of g_weatherChoices (filled by RallyData_BuildCountryWeatherIndexMap), its weather symbol texture (Textures\\Weather\\Symbols) and its text 0x9d + type (Bright, Dry, Cloudy, ... after the text base); no flag is drawn.
